depiction.primary_object: seated person in profile facing left
modifiers: horizontal arrow pointing right toward face
vertical arrow pointing down toward feet
depiction.composition: side-by-side profile symbol, automotive dashboard style

readings.meaning: car climate control bi-level airflow (face and feet vents)
vehicle air conditioning, HVAC, or cabin ventilation
ergonomic seating position or posture adjustment

ambiguity: Outside an automotive context, viewers may misread the arrows as directions for standing up/sitting down or moving a chair.

modifier_semantics.meaning: airflow directed to upper body / dashboard face vents
airflow directed to floor / footwell vents

reasoning: This is the standard ISO automotive symbol for bi-level cabin airflow (directing air to the upper body and feet). While it is technically a specific car climate-control setting, it serves well as a recognizable emblem for vehicle A/C, heater, cabin air filter, and ventilation maintenance tasks, though non-drivers might mistake it for a generic seating or posture icon.
